title: Burnout Revenge (Burnout Revenge for Mac)
description: Unofficial native Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360, USA) port for Apple silicon Macs (macOS 15+). Static recompilation, up to 4K rendering via Vulkan/MoltenVK, controller support and experimental online play. Requires your own USA Xbox 360 ISO; no game data included. Based on SpeedBreaker.
